value.rationale: The color-unlabeled quotient is a natural intrinsic topological object for cyclic partial assignment data. An exact all-parameter quotient invariant and the sharp q=5 exponential lower bound demonstrate topology that persists after erasing all color labels, unlike many quotients that annihilate homology. This is a structural, unbounded family theorem, not a finite instance or minor coefficient improvement.
